summary: IsoEnergy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, furnishing a news release announcing two senior technical appointments: Nathan Bridge, M.Sc., P.Geo., as Vice President, Exploration, and Dr. Dan Brisbin, P.Geo., transitioning from Vice President, Exploration to the newly created Vice President, Geology role. No financial terms, securities, or shareholder interests are implicated; there is no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock because this is an ordinary executive appointment rather than a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO/board departure. Watch only for execution on Hurricane and Larocque East exploration programs.
